can_do: Try one safe Play click on the selected result
Use media keys for next, previous, pause, and resume
limits: Spotify has no reliable local public API without login/developer setup
Ads, login screens, layout changes, or device selection can block automation
Nova must not claim a song is playing unless it can verify it
spotify.execution_rule: If a song name is given, search then click one likely result. If no song name is given, open a playlist/current context and click Play only once.

limits: WhatsApp Desktop does not expose a guaranteed public call/message automation API
Login, permissions, layout changes, or contact ambiguity can block automation
Nova must never open Google for WhatsApp unless the user clearly asks for web/browser
whatsapp.execution_rule: Always try local WhatsApp Desktop first; report exactly what was attempted.

can_do: Open the first found video when Python web access can read results
limits: Nova cannot guarantee a video started unless it can inspect the player
youtube.execution_rule: Use YouTube only when the user says YouTube or asks web video playback.

can_do: Open Google services when permission is ON
Use online AI for answers when API is reachable
limits: Search result pages are opened in browser; Nova does not silently click unknown results
google.execution_rule: Use Google search only for explicit search/google commands, not failed app-open commands.

can_do: Open a compose draft with recipient/subject/body
commands: compose email to name@example.com subject hello body hi
limits: Sending, deleting, archiving, or marking emails requires user review/final click
gmail.execution_rule: Never send or delete email automatically.

can_do: Toggle some settings by supported safe APIs
limits: Some Windows toggles are blocked by design or need manual confirmation/UAC
windows_settings.execution_rule: Verify or say best-effort; never say done when Windows only opened a settings page.

can_do: Open named files from common folders
commands: make python file with date time code
limits: Nova scans common folders and its own workspace, not every private file on the whole disk by default
files.execution_rule: Use selected/uploaded file first, then known common folders; avoid guessing wrong files.

limits: Local edits are Pillow/FFmpeg drafts; true semantic image/video generation needs a connected AI model/API
media_studio.execution_rule: Work only on selected files for GUI media tasks; never mix old latest files with selected files.
